tagline: A growing competitive club bringing the Olympic sport of team handball to the University of Georgia. No experience needed — most of us had never played before joining.
practiceInfo: Fridays 5:30–7:30 PM, Sundays 6:00–8:00 PM, and Mondays 7:30–9:30 PM (starting October 26) at the Ramsey Student Center, Gym West. No experience needed — we'll teach you everything on the court.
